title: Jet rigidity of Mather's $β$-function and complexified KAM curves holomorphic in potential for analytic standard maps
summary: Mather's $β$-function associates with each rotation number the least average action carried by an orbit of a twist map. For analytic standard maps in the KAM regime, we prove the following. For any family of $d \ge 1$ directions of perturbation satisfying a natural symmetry condition, the jet of the $β$-function at a single algebraic Diophantine rotation number locally determines the potential for an open and prevalent, hence dense, set of base potentials in the KAM domain.
